ambient: It runs on past the point where you stop it.
The thing you did is done again, at the speed it happened.
description: Something is watching a thing you did, with you, from the position you were in at the time. It has no opinion. It stays for the whole of it, including the parts you have never let run to the end, and it's still there afterwards.
name: The Witness

looks: From where you were standing. The angle is right.
It takes as long as it took. Not longer.
The part you remember is a small part of it and it's in there.
objects.name: the thing you did

looks: Present. Watching. Not judging and not withholding judgement.
It was there at the time, which is a thing you hadn't considered.
It has no face and it's turned the same way as you.
objects.name: the witness

weather: Still, with no draught, in a space that has stopped for this.
